name: Dar Global

summary.text: Dar Global PLC is the international arm of the Saudi-listed developer Dar Al Arkan, admitted to the London Stock Exchange main market on February 28, 2023 with Dar Al Arkan holding 88 percent of its shares. It is the Trump Organization's development partner for Trump-branded projects announced in 2024-26 in Jeddah, Dubai, Qatar (Simaisma, with Qatari Diar), the Maldives, Riyadh (Wadi Safar) and Oman. In February 2026 World Liberty Financial, Securitize and Dar Global announced a tokenized private placement tied to the Maldives resort. Yousef Al Shelash is chairman of Dar Al Arkan, Dar Global's parent; Ziad El Chaar is Dar Global's chief executive. Trump's financial disclosures reported about $21.9 million in 2024 income and, per CNBC's analysis, about $25.8 million in 2025 income from Dar Al Arkan and Dar Global.

facts.claim: Dar Global PLC was admitted to the main market of the London Stock Exchange on February 28, 2023, described as the first Saudi company listed there. A pre-listing private placement raised gross proceeds of $72 million, giving a day-one market capitalisation of about $600 million, and Dar Al Arkan held 88 percent of the share capital on admission. Dar Al Arkan described Dar Global as its international arm and the listing as valuing it at 2.25 billion Saudi riyals.

facts.claim: Dar Global's partner page lists its Trump-branded portfolio across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar, the Maldives and Oman. Company and Trump Organization releases record Trump Tower Jeddah (launched December 2024), Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai (April 30, 2025), Trump International Golf Club and villas at Simaisma, Qatar (April 30, 2025) and Trump International Hotel Maldives (November 17, 2025).

facts.claim: In January 2026 the group announced two further Saudi projects: Trump International at Wadi Safar near Riyadh (January 11, 2026, with Dar Al Arkan and Diriyah Company) and Trump Plaza Jeddah, a mixed-use district valued at over $1 billion within the Amaya development (January 12, 2026), described as the third collaboration with the Trump Organization in Saudi Arabia. Dar Al Arkan had earlier announced Trump-branded villas, a hotel and golf course at its AIDA project in Muscat, Oman.

facts.claim: On February 19, 2026 World Liberty Financial announced that it would tokenize loan revenue interests in the Trump International Hotel & Resort, Maldives, in partnership with Dar Global and Securitize. The tokens are offered in a private placement under Rule 506(c) of Regulation D to verified accredited investors, or to non-U.S. persons under Regulation S, are not registered under the Securities Act and carry transfer restrictions. Securitize's offering page names the issuer as WLFI DAR Maldives Limited. Dar Global states that it uses the Trump name solely under a trademark licence agreement.

facts.claim: Yousef Al Shelash is chairman and co-founder of Dar Al Arkan, Dar Global's parent. Forbes reported in May 2025 that he had struck at least six Trump-branded real-estate deals over three years in Dubai, Oman, Qatar and Saudi Arabia, that he attended a lunch with President Trump during the May 2025 Riyadh visit, and that the White House said there were no conflicts of interest. In the January 2026 Wadi Safar announcement he said the project 'captures the prestige and the legacy of the Trump brand'.

facts.claim: Forbes reported in June 2025 that Donald Trump's financial disclosure covering 2024 listed about $21.9 million in revenue from Dar Al Arkan, roughly the same as in his previous disclosure. For 2025, The Real Deal, citing CNBC's analysis of the 2026 disclosure, reported $25.8 million in licensing income from Dar Al Arkan and Dar Global and $11.3 million from Dubai's Damac; The National reported Gulf developers paid about $38 million in licensing fees in total, including $5.25 million from the Qatar golf project.

facts.claim: On October 7, 2026 Reuters reported that Dar Global planned to begin construction of the Trump International Golf Club Simaisma in Qatar in early 2027, with villas, priced from 5 million Qatari riyals, expected to be completed by the end of 2030.

facts.claim: Forbes Middle East reported that Dar Global manages 17 active projects across the Middle East and Europe with an estimated gross development value of $12.5 billion and described it as Dar Al Arkan's majority-owned associate; Dar Global's H1 2026 results, per its newswire page, reported 66 percent revenue growth and a portfolio gross development value of $23 billion.

openQuestions: Dar Global's own board composition (and whether Yousef Al Shelash chairs Dar Global as well as Dar Al Arkan) was not confirmed from a company filing; the sources reached name him as chairman of the parent and Ziad El Chaar as Dar Global's CEO.
Dar Al Arkan's current percentage holding in Dar Global after the 2023 listing was not found; the 88 percent figure is as of admission.

The split of Trump's Gulf licensing income differs by outlet ($21.9 million from Dar Al Arkan per Forbes for 2024; $25.8 million from Dar Al Arkan and Dar Global per The Real Deal/CNBC for 2025; $38 million total Gulf fees per The National); the OGE filings were not opened.

The Oman AIDA project's Trump component was announced by Dar Al Arkan rather than Dar Global; Dar Global's partner page lists Muscat among its Trump locations, but a Dar Global release for it was not found.
The villa count for the Maldives resort is given as about 80 in the November 2025 release and about 100 in the February 2026 release.
